# Hugsy

> Animation-heavy, copy-and-own SwiftUI components for iOS 17+ and Swift 6.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://hugsi.pulkit.page/docs/): CLI installation, integration, and MCP configuration.
- [Complete guide](https://hugsi.pulkit.page/llms-full.txt): all component metadata and usage.
- [JSON registry](https://hugsi.pulkit.page/r/index.json): versioned source files and SHA-256 checksums.

## Local tools

Run `hugsy list --json`, `hugsy info <name> --json`, `hugsy init`, and `hugsy add <name> --dry-run --json`.
Run `hugsy mcp` for read-only tools, resources, and an integration prompt over stdio.
Never overwrite customized source without explicit permission. The Swift source has no third-party dependencies.
